properties.name_zh: 普通服务基线与通行证建档闸门
properties.gate_input: 非 AI 等效路径、无障碍物理服务、数据边界、拟议责任角色与现场使用条件可记录。
properties.decision_roles: 服务通行证接收角色与公共利益监督角色共同决定；任一方可拒收。
properties.gate_output: 可填写的四合同通行证、纸质/人工服务连续性记录、拒收清单。
properties.failed_destination: 退回服务提案人；保持普通服务，不进入受控测试。
properties.design_status: proposed evidence-gated sequence; no approved schedule, procurement award, partner commitment or construction timetable implied
properties.v13_decision_chain: submit → verify → accept/refuse → pause → restoration acceptance

properties.name_zh: 受控验证与资源账本闸门
properties.gate_input: 通过 Phase 0；测试包络、维护分流、停机条件、资源记录方法和人工接管准备可审阅。
properties.decision_roles: 接口核验、资源账本与安全维护角色共同决定；公共利益角色可暂停。
properties.gate_output: 跨栈、能源—热环境和退出恢复三类拟议证据包；未测量结果不得转成环境收益主张。
properties.failed_destination: 安全停机并回到纸质/人工路径；设备不进入公共前台。
properties.design_status: proposed evidence-gated sequence; no approved schedule, procurement award, partner commitment or construction timetable implied
properties.v13_decision_chain: submit → verify → accept/refuse → pause → restoration acceptance

properties.name_zh: 有限公共评估与联合退出闸门
properties.name_en: Limited public evaluation and joint-exit gate
properties.gate_input: 通过 Phase 1；无障碍、人工责任、公开解释、争议/申诉渠道和普通服务连续性可复核。
properties.decision_roles: 公共利益、普通服务与退出恢复角色共同决定；任何一方可要求暂停或归还。
properties.gate_output: 公开可复现的证据摘要、市民评估记录、恢复验收表。
properties.failed_destination: 撤出设备、断开服务、迁移或删除按边界执行，恢复普通公共空间和非 AI 服务。
properties.design_status: proposed evidence-gated sequence; no approved schedule, procurement award, partner commitment or construction timetable implied
properties.v13_gate_input: limited public evaluation and joint exit/restoration
properties.v13_decision_chain: submit → verify → accept/refuse → pause → restoration acceptance
